title: TELE-LC: Specialized Telemonitoring for Pediatric PAIVS-ME/CFS
summary:
The "TELE-LC" study is investigating telemedical monitoring of children and adolescents with post acute infectious and vaccination syndrome (PAIVS) such as post-COVID and ME/CS using a specially developed app, various connected test devices and symptom questionnaires .
The primary focus of the study is to investigate whether telemonitoring in this population is feasible. Additionally, the study is intended to contribute to the collection and evaluation of more closely meshed data and information on the course of the disease in children and adolescents suffering from PAIVS including ME/CFS. In addition, it will be investigated which factors are important for the success of such telemedical support of children and adolescents.
In this way, we would like to examine whether and how routine treatment of PAIVS and ME/CFS can be usefully supplemented in the future. Furthermore, we would like to derive insights from this study as to how telemonitoring could complement national care strategies for patients and their families living with PAIVS including ME/CFS. Lastly, the collected results could help to better understand how we can use telemedical monitoring in chronic conditions that affect children and adolescents.

interventions.name: App-based telemonitoring for Post-Acute Infectious Syndromes (PAIVS) such as post-COVID, post-Vac and ME/CFS in children and adolescents. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Clinical diagnosis:
- For PCS and other PAIVS: Meeting the WHO criteria for paediatric post-
COVID syndrome
- For ME/CFS: Meeting the Canada Consensus Criteria for ME/CFS
• Severity of illness: Moderate to severe illness defined as limited
participation in daily life of ≤ 50% according to the MCFC Participation Scale and/or a low Bell Score < 50
• Language skills: Sufficient knowledge of German on the part of the patient and at least one parent or legal guardian
• Technical requirements: Availability of a smartphone with a sufficiently
up-to-date operating system to install the SaniQ patient app
• Capacity to give consent
• Timing of onset: Patients who meet the diagnostic criteria and continue to
be affected by the condition at the severity level defined above may participate
in the study at any time, even if they have had PAIVS-ME/CFS for a considerable period of time.
Exclusion criteria:
• Patients who have already participated in the studies “coverCHILD Telemonitoring” or “TYME – Telemonitoring for Youth ME/CFS” will not be included.
• Participation in other research projects does not constitute a criterion for exclusion.
